# Ockley Labs - HR document archive

Shared archive for HR documents. Handbooks are archived by version under docs/, file names carry the version number, and older versions are kept, never overwritten. The expense claim form is filed separately under forms/.
files.docs/onboarding-handbook-v3.md:
# Ockley Labs - Onboarding handbook (v3, 2025 edition)

## Badge access

Badges are collected from reception on day one and activate within 2 hours.

## Probation

Probation is 3 months with a review in week 10.

## Expense limits

Meals are reimbursed up to 25 per day on travel days (2025 limits).

# Expense form notes

Use the current expense claim form from the finance share; receipts below 10 can be pooled weekly.
